definitions.explanation: A clever trick, shortcut, or hidden technique not widely known. Originally used for hidden commands in video games, now broadly applied to any insider tip or life hack.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏技|うらわざ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This game has a lot of secret tricks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏技|うらわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: Someone taught me a cooking hack.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧ (hidden side, behind the scenes) and ⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧ (technique, skill).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏技|うらわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use a hidden trick)
- {裏技|うらわざ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ (teach a secret trick)
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏技|うらわざ} (life hack)
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{裏技|うらわざ} (money-saving hack)

Originally popularized in the context of video games (cheat codes, hidden features, Easter eggs), the word has expanded to mean any clever insider tip. It is very common in lifestyle media, cooking shows, and online content, where it is essentially equivalent to the English "life hack." The tone is informal and positive — a {裏技|うらわざ} is a welcome shortcut, not something underhanded.
